title: Bird Flight
shortDescription: Tap to fly through the pipes. How far can you get?
fullDescription:
Bird Flight is a vibrant and addictive arcade game that challenges your reflexes and precision. Navigate your bird through an endless obstacle course of pipes, aiming for the highest score while unlocking dazzling visual rewards.

Key Features:

Classic Gameplay: Simple one-touch controls (Tap, Click, or Spacebar) make it easy to learn but hard to master.
Dynamic Reward System: Experience a "dopamine-driven" progression system with XP, leveling, and unlockable achievements.
Visual Spectacle: Celebrate your milestones with dynamic particle effects (sparkles, confetti, and fire) that trigger as you reach score benchmarks (10, 20, 30, 50+).
Local Leaderboard: Compete against yourself and friends with a built-in high score tracking system.
Responsive Design: optimized for both desktop and mobile play with smooth 60 FPS performance.
